name: sideshow
description: Stream sideshow browser comments to Claude Code as notifications, and publish snippets over MCP.

sideshowUrl.title: Sideshow URL
sideshowUrl.description: Base URL of your sideshow server. Local default is http://localhost:8228; set your deployed instance (e.g. https://sideshow.you.workers.dev) otherwise.

apiToken.title: Sideshow token
apiToken.description: Bearer token for a deployed sideshow instance. Leave blank for a local server.
